summary: The audit checks 25 units: ANTHRO 120H (Introduction to the Medical Humanities) and the ANTHRO 143 workshop, plus four more courses for 20 units from the list. Checked by hand: that those four courses come from at least two disciplines, and up to 10 units of unlisted courses you petition for and move in. The final presentation and a methods course are encouraged, not required. Transfer credit is not accepted.

m1v7oiYT.why: "Students should earn a minimum of 25 units: 4 in the core course, Introduction to the Medical Humanities; 1 for participation in the workshop for at least one quarter; 20 more in at least 4 courses from at least two disciplines connected to Medical Humanities"

ye5Fe29Z.why: "20 units of additional coursework in at least 4 courses from at least two disciplines connected to Medical Humanities, including a possible 2 units for final presentation preparation." "Students can also petition up to 10 units of courses not included on the pre-approved list" (moved in by hand). "At least two disciplines" is checked by hand.

Hdadug9O.why: "students are highly encouraged to present", "Students will be encouraged to take a methods course", "It is recommended", "We also recommend": recommendations, not requirements.
